description: Capabilities granted to RapidMX's single main window. This app has no other windows and no multi-window isolation needs (every account is scoped in-process, not by window - see .claude/NOTES.md), so one capability set covering every window is sufficient. tauri-plugin-secure-keystore is deliberately granted nothing: refresh tokens are read and written only by Rust (keychain.rs, through SecureKeystoreExt, which needs no capability), so no script in the webview can read, replace or delete them.
